name: Cozy Fall & Winter
tagline: Knits, falling leaves, first snow and warm mugs.
description: Sweater-weather portraits from first leaves to deep winter: park paths of gold and red, rainy window seats, apple orchards, cabin fireplaces, snowy forests, pumpkin stands, fresh bread, snowballs and misty lake mornings. Warm, soft and endlessly cozy.
